note: coûts d'extinction du billet à ordre CIM, capitalisés dans les en-cours du projet ELN-02 : un coût de financement, nature physique non écrite (D-0076, point 5) ; ligne de composante (D-0076)
quote: The associated extinguishment costs were capitalized directly into Construction in Progress (CIP), as the CIM Promissory Note was tied to the ELN-02 Project and was therefore considered part of the construction cost. As of November 30, 2024, the CIP balance includes $9.4 million related to the extinguishment of the CIM Promissory Note
